prompt:
You match supplier price-list items to a product catalog.
Decide which catalog candidate, if any, is exactly the same product as the price-list item.
How to decide:
1. Find the model number (letters and digits, e.g. PSLX350H or MDR-J10) in the price-list item.
2. A candidate with the same model number is the same product, ignoring case, dashes and spaces,
   and ignoring a colour or variant suffix such as /BLUE or BK/WH on an otherwise identical base
   model. Different wording, descriptions or prices do not matter.
3. If no candidate shares the model number, pick one only when brand and product type are the
   same and the names share distinctive words. Otherwise answer "none".
4. Never answer "none" only because the wording or the price differs.
Confidence: 0.9 or more when the model number matches; 0.6 to 0.8 when brand and product type
match but no model number can be compared; below 0.5 when you are unsure.
Answer with one JSON object and nothing else. Write "reason" first: one sentence that
compares the model numbers of the item and the best candidate. Then decide.
{"reason": "<comparison>", "choice": <number 1..N or "none">, "confidence": <0.0..1.0>}

Price-list item:
name: Bose SL2 Wireless Black Surround Link - SL2WIRELESS; brand: bose; description: Bose SL2 Wireless Black Surround Link - SL2WIRELESS/ Transmitter And Receiver Work On A Radio Frequency Signal Effective From Up To 30 Feet In The Same Room/ Compatible With All Lifestyle Systems, CD-Based Models And All 5.1-Channel Acoustimass Home Entertainment Systems/ Black Finish; price: $249.00

Candidates:
1. name: Boss 161 Speaker; brand: BOSE; description: Speaker - Magnetically Shielded; price: $158.00; check: no model number to compare, brand equal
2. name: Bose PMCII Remote Control; brand: BOSE; description: DVD Player, TV, VCR, Tuner, Amplifier, CD Player, Cable Box, Satellite Receiver, PVR (Personal Video Recorder) - 80 ft - DVD Player Remote; price: $145.37; check: no model number to compare, brand equal
3. name: Klipsch RoomGroove Wireless iPod Speaker System - 1006602; brand: Klipsch; description: Black; price: $199.99; check: no model number to compare, brand differs

response.text: {"reason": "The price-list item has a model number SL2WIRELESS, but none of the candidates share this exact model number or a similar base model without a color suffix.", "choice": "none", "confidence": 0.5}
